content.title: Hilti M6x25-Grade 5 Hex Bolt, M6x1mm, 25mm Length, Carbon Steel, SAE J429 Grade 5
content.short_description: Hilti M6x25-Grade 5 hex bolt with external hex drive, M6x1mm thread, 25mm length, carbon steel construction rated to SAE J429 Grade 5 (830 MPa tensile strength).
content.long_description:
The Hilti M6x25-Grade 5 is a carbon steel hex bolt manufactured to SAE J429 Grade 5 specifications, with a minimum tensile strength of 830 MPa. It features an external hex drive head and a hex bolt fastener type, suited for applications requiring a standard wrench or socket for installation and removal.

Thread specifications are M6 with a 1mm pitch, and the bolt has an overall length of 25mm. The Grade 5 property class indicates a medium-strength fastener commonly specified for structural and mechanical assembly applications where SAE-rated tensile performance is required.

Material is carbon steel, consistent with SAE J429 Grade 5 requirements. Confirm thread engagement depth and mating nut or tapped hole compatibility before installation, as M6x1mm pitch must match the mating thread.
